summary: Florentine youth named in the anonymous denunciations of 1476 in which Leonardo was also named.

claims.statement: The anonymous denunciation of 9 April 1476 to the Ufficiali di Notte names Saltarelli and four men, among them Leonardo and Lionardo Tornabuoni.

claims.statement: The charge was dismissed 'cum conditione ut retamburentur' (on condition of no further accusation); a second denunciation is recorded in June 1476. Sources differ on the date and on whether this was an acquittal.
